item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Scholarly Evaluation
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in the Journal of Informetrics focuses on the intersection of artificial intelligence and scholarly evaluation. The call invites research exploring how AI technologies are being applied to, and impacting, various aspects of academic evaluation and assessment.

Appel publié par Journal of Informetrics. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
